subject: Private deployment onboarding — environment readiness & telemetry gating
messages:
From: Sara Kline <sara.k@patchwell.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Ortega <michael@patchwell.com>
Date: 2025-03-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private deploy intake for Patchwell — next steps

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Patchwell is ready to move from evaluation to a Private deployment (VPC) for beta traffic. Attached is a high-level network diagram and a raw checklist our infrastructure team uses.

High level asks we have up front:
- Egress IPs for firewall allowlist (we need stable CIDR blocks).
- KMS/HSM integration options and whether Redwood can use our customer-managed keys.
- Telemetry/agent footprint: what endpoints we must allow and whether we can opt out of certain metrics.
- A short mutual action plan and expected timeline for day-0 smoke tests.

Can you share a recommended onboarding checklist and identify the team members from Redwood we'll coordinate with? Also, is there an intake doc or form you want us to fill?

Sara
Sara Kline
Head of Platform, Patchwell

Attachments: patchwell_network_diagram.pdf (diagram), patchwell_raw_env_checklist.xlsx

From: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Kline <sara.k@patchwell.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-03-14T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deploy intake for Patchwell — next steps

Sara — thanks for the note and the diagram. Looping in Ben (on onboarding/ops), Kimberly (networking & KMS), and Marcus (runtime & telemetry).

Short answer: we have a compact ‘Seatbelt’ checklist we use for Private deployments that covers the items you called out. I attached our standard checklist (redwood_private_onboard_checklist.xlsx) and a one-page KMS options summary.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Patchwell to confirm the list of egress IPs/port ranges used for your bastion/CI so we can provide allowlist candidates (Ben).
2) Kimberly to confirm compatibility with your KMS provider and map required IAM/service-account flows.
3) Marcus and I to schedule a 60-minute day-0 smoke-test window (we recommend a mid-week morning) to run connectivity, small inference traffic, and KV cache validation.

Notes & constraints (quick):
- Our private control plane needs access to your certificate/registry endpoints for image pulls unless you mirror images into a customer registry (we can support either).
- Telemetry: we can reduce retention or anonymize IDs if required; some telemetry is mandatory for SLA reasons.

I’ve put proposed owners on action items in the attached. If that looks good I’ll draft a mutual action plan with dates.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_private_onboard_checklist.xlsx, kms_requirements_summary.docx

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Sara Kline <sara.k@patchwell.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-03-15T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deploy intake for Patchwell — next steps

Sara — quick follow-up from my side.

We generally provide a stable set of egress IP ranges for customer firewall allowlists tied to the Dedicated/Private cluster that will host your workload. To avoid surprises we need:
- Your CI/bastion source IPs that will reach the internal registry and the bastion port (SSH).
- Any third-party webhooks or callback endpoints you call from the model runtime (we need those opened).

About image pull: if you prefer, we can stage images on our side for the smoke test and move to your customer registry before cutover. If you want to host images in your registry, please provide a service account with pull permissions or set up a short-lived token we can consume during onboarding.

Proposed dates for day-0 smoke run: March 19 or March 21, 09:00–11:00 PT. Which works for you?

Ben Carter
Customer Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Kline <sara.k@patchwell.com>, ben.carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-03-16T10:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deploy intake for Patchwell — next steps

Sara — a few clarifications from the KMS/network side.

1) KMS: We support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS and external HSMs (bring-your-own HSM) for on-prem racks. If you want us to encrypt runtime artifacts with your CMK, we need:
   - A cross-account IAM role with kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey permission (for AWS KMS).
   - For external HSM, a short certificate exchange and an endpoint for the HSM gateway.

2) Network: our runtime uses the following egress flows during lifecycle ops (please open/allow as needed):
   - 52.24.210.0/24 (image pulls & control plane) TCP 443
   - 52.24.211.0/28 (health checks & telemetry) TCP 443
   - NTP: outbound UDP 123 to your NTP servers (or we can use public NTP)

3) Telemetry: If Patchwell needs reduced telemetry, we can set a minimal footprint mode (no stack traces, sampling on traces). Note that disabling traces will reduce our ability to root-cause latency regressions.

Action items for Patchwell: share an IAM role ARN for KMS or confirm HSM readiness; confirm firewall rules for the IP ranges above; indicate whether images will be pulled from Patchwell registry or Redwood mirror.

Kimberly Park
Network & Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — this is great. A couple of quick notes from our infra owner: 

- Patchwell will provide a read-only service account for image pulls; we will also confirm the IPs for our CI system by EOD 3/18.
- We prefer AWS KMS with a cross-account role. Michael will post the ARN by tomorrow.
- For telemetry, minimal footprint is fine for now; would you still collect SLA-critical traces? If so, can we limit retention to 7 days?

Also — can you send a short mutual action plan with proposed dates for the two-week onboarding window? If we can run the smoke test on the 21st that fits our release calendar.

Appreciate the clarity — Sara/Michael
